purpose: The memory layer: where every record is stored. The other layers each define the records they write here and the conventions for them; this layer defines only how a record is stored and found (route, schema, provenance), the decision log, the venture profile, design documents and the sources behind them. Storage is federated: records stay in the sources a venture already uses (its own folder by default, or a GitHub repository), reached through connectors with one contract, found through a catalog that copies no content (EE-036, EE-037).
gaps: No check on the venture profile or design documents of its own; design-coverage (evidence) is the only one
Two connectors so far (filesystem and GitHub); a database, Notion, Slack or Salesforce each need their own module meeting the same contract
Checks and command routes (need-now, time-to-ready, validation score) still read the venture folder, so they do not yet see a record kept in another source
A merged pull request is not logged as an accept in provenance; the read after the merge is the only sign

Freshness (schema/freshness.mjs) checks children in the venture folder only; a child in another source is listed as needing the platform, and a webhook from a system of record that marks summaries stale (V-9) is the platform's
name: knowledge
